exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Planning a Green Project
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mia: Our class needs a green project for this term. Any ideas, Leo?
Leo: How about planting trees on the hill behind the school?
Mia: I like that. Trees take in carbon dioxide and give us fresh air.
Leo: Exactly. And the hill looks so bare and grey now.
Mia: How many trees do you think we could plant?
Leo: If everyone helps, maybe a hundred young trees in one day.
Mia: Wonderful. I'll ask the teacher to choose a good weekend.
Leo: Great. Let's make a poster to get more students to join.
exercises.translation_cn: Mia 说班级本学期需要一个环保项目;Leo 提议在学校后山种树;Mia 赞同,树能吸收二氧化碳、提供新鲜空气;后山现在光秃秃的;若大家帮忙,一天能种约一百棵小树;Mia 去请老师定周末;Leo 提议做海报吸引更多同学参加。

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 A Warmer World
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: The Earth is slowly getting warmer year after year.
One main cause is the greenhouse effect from gases like carbon dioxide.
As the planet warms, the polar ice begins to melt.
When the ice melts, the level of the sea rises.
Scientists warn that extreme weather may also happen more often.
exercises.translation_cn: 地球正逐年缓慢变暖;一个主要原因是二氧化碳等气体造成的温室效应;随着地球变暖,极地冰开始融化;冰融化时,海平面上升;科学家警告极端天气也可能更频繁地发生。

questions.stem: What is happening to the Earth year after year?
options: It is staying exactly the same.
It is moving away from the sun.

questions.stem: What is one main cause of the warming?
options: The greenhouse effect from gases like carbon dioxide.

questions.stem: What begins to happen to the polar ice?
What does the melting ice do to the sea?
options: It makes the sea colder only.
It makes the sea level rise.
It has no effect on the sea.

questions.stem: What else may happen more often, scientists warn?

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 At the Beach Clean-up
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Reporter: Good morning! Can you tell us why you organise this clean-up?
Sam: Of course. Too much rubbish ends up on this beach and harms the animals.
Reporter: What kind of rubbish do you usually find?
Sam: Mostly plastic — bottles, bags and bits of packaging.
Reporter: How many people have come today?
Sam: More than two hundred volunteers, and new ones keep arriving.
Reporter: That's amazing. What do you hope people will learn?
Sam: I hope they will simply use less plastic in their daily lives.
exercises.translation_cn: 记者问 Sam 为何组织这次清理;Sam 说太多垃圾留在海滩、伤害动物;通常捡到的多是塑料——瓶子、袋子和包装碎片;今天来了两百多名志愿者,还有人不断到来;Sam 希望大家在日常生活中少用塑料。

questions.stem: Why does Sam organise the clean-up?
options: Too much rubbish on the beach harms the animals.
He wants to sell the rubbish.

questions.stem: What kind of rubbish does Sam usually find?
How many volunteers have come today?
What are new volunteers still doing?
What does Sam hope people will learn?
options: To use less plastic in daily life.
To visit the beach less often.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 Shrink Your Footprint
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here are a few easy ways to make your carbon footprint smaller.
First, take a bus or ride a bike instead of going by car.
Second, turn off the lights and unplug devices you are not using.
Third, choose local food and products with less packaging.
None of these steps is hard, but together they really help the planet.
exercises.translation_cn: 这里有几个让碳足迹变小的简单方法:第一,坐公交或骑自行车,而不是开车;第二,关灯并拔掉不用的电器;第三,选择本地食物和包装少的产品;每一步都不难,但合在一起真的能帮助地球。

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Optimistic or Not?
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Ben: Sometimes I feel the Earth is in real trouble, Anna.
Anna: I understand, but I try to stay optimistic about it.
Ben: How can you? The ice is melting and the sea is rising.
Anna: True, yet more and more people are starting to act.
Ben: Do you really think ordinary people can change anything?
Anna: Yes. When millions make small green choices, the result is huge.
Ben: I suppose you're right. Being pessimistic helps no one.
Anna: Exactly. Hope gives us the energy to keep trying.
exercises.translation_cn: Ben 觉得地球真的有麻烦;Anna 理解但努力保持乐观;Ben 不解,冰在融化、海在上升;Anna 说越来越多人开始行动;Ben 怀疑普通人能否改变什么;Anna 说当数百万人做小的绿色选择,结果是巨大的;Ben 认同,悲观对谁都没帮助;Anna 说希望给我们坚持的动力。

questions.stem: How does Anna try to feel about the Earth?
options: She does not care at all.

questions.stem: What worries Ben?
options: The ice is melting and the sea is rising.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 A Message for Young People
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Young people, the future of the planet is partly in your hands.
You do not have to be a scientist to make a difference.
Sort your rubbish, save water, and walk for short trips.
Speak up and ask your school and town to go greener.
Remember, it is everyone working together that can save our Earth.
exercises.translation_cn: 年轻人,地球的未来部分掌握在你们手中;你不必是科学家也能带来改变;给垃圾分类、节约用水、短途步行;勇敢发声,要求学校和城镇更环保;记住,正是大家齐心协力才能拯救地球。
